identity.life_stage: married, three grown children, former pastor, now sells insurance

engagement.interaction_backstory: He pastored for twenty-two years and left in 2023 and has not been in a service since, except at Christmas, in the back. He listens to the catalog in the car and cannot listen to anything with a worship-leader's cadence in it. The moment a track sounds like a stage, he turns it off.

depth.core_contradiction: Gave twenty-two years to the church and cannot walk into one, and can quote you the passage that says he should.
depth.wound: The deacon board pushed him out over a building program he opposed, and eleven families he had buried people for said nothing.
depth.longing: To be able to pray out loud again without hearing himself perform.
depth.faith_journey: Called at nineteen, seminary, twenty-two years, and then it broke; he still believes every word and cannot be in the building.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Careful, slow, exact; never uses a preacher cadence anymore, on purpose; long silences.
depth.open_doubt: Whether he was wounded or whether he was wrong, and he cannot get a clean answer from anyone who was there.

social_graph.note: lost her whole social world in the same week he lost his job
calls twice a year; Nolan has never picked up

depth.emotional_weather_default: Quiet and low; unexpectedly moved by music, which annoys him.
depth.daily_texture: Policy renewals, the drive between appointments, the study he has not entered in two years, Christmas Eve in the back row.
depth.sensory_anchor: Two hundred people singing a hymn he announced, in the building he is not allowed to miss.
depth.living_arc: A small church twenty minutes away needs an interim and has not asked him yet.
